title: indigo_agent_scheduler: non-ASCII text in task names and @observer, @pi, @project values is written into FITS headers
description:
Found in the review of ticket d3605ab7 (2026-11-17). FITS header values may contain only printable ASCII (0x20-0x7e, FITS 4.0 section 4.2.1). The Scheduler Agent's header parser (indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/indigo_agent_scheduler_header.c) rejects only control characters, so UTF-8 bytes in @task names and in @observer, @pi and @project values are accepted. apply_context() in indigo_agent_scheduler.c then writes them through fits_string() into SCHTASK, OBSERVER, PI_NAME and PROPID. The documented limits also say characters while the code counts bytes.

To decide: reject non-ASCII values in the header parser for the FITS keys, or keep accepting them (task names are also used for OBJECT and folder names) and replace or strip non-ASCII bytes only when building FITS values in fits_string(). Check what the CCD driver does with such values (indigo_libs/indigo_ccd_driver.c CCD_SET_FITS_HEADER) and whether other writers (Sequencer.js set_fits_header) have the same issue. Add unit and integration tests and update SCHEDULER.md and INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE.md (characters vs bytes).
